newsitem.title: USA: Hoechst names AT&T telecom provider.
newsitem.headline: Hoechst names AT&T telecom provider.

text.p: Hoechst AG and AT&T Corp said in a joint statement that AT&T will serve as the primary telecommunications services provider to Hoechst's worldwide businesses.
The companies said this arrangement has a potential value of up to $50 million annually.

In the initial contract between AT&T and Hoechst's HiServ telecommunications subsidiary, AT&T will provide frame relay and router management services in Western Europe, with transatlantic links to Hoechst's sites in the United States, the companies said.
